question: I’m based in Boston now. My Canadian passport is expiring, and my employer sent me the U.S. passport renewal page. Which renewal instructions should I start with?
generated_answer: You should start with the U.S. passport renewal page, since you live and work in the U.S. and the U.S. passport is the passport you will use most frequently. You may renew your Canadian passport at any time. It doesn’t matter where you are in the world. You can renew your passport from abroad, but you can’t get a new passport from abroad. You will need to apply in person at a passport office or submit your application by mail from the United States. The process is the same as applying from Canada. You will need to provide proof of Canadian citizenship and identity and pay the application fee. You will also need to provide a copy of your U.S. passport or other acceptable identification. The processing time for a passport renewal application from the United States is approximately 4 to 6 weeks. However, it may take longer if your application is incomplete or if there are any issues with your application. If you are in a hurry, you can request expedited service, which will cost an additional fee. The processing time for an expedited application is approximately 2 to 3 weeks.
